en.headline: Two men arrested after drugs found in Tsing Yi light goods vehicle
en.dek: Police seized about 44.5 grams of suspected crack cocaine, e-cigarette cartridges and drug paraphernalia valued at roughly HK$45,000 after a report of suspected drug use late on Tuesday.
body: Police arrested two men on Tuesday night after finding suspected dangerous drugs and related items inside a light goods vehicle parked opposite No. 10 Fung Shui Wo Road in Tsing Yi.

Officers responded at about 9:31 p.m. to a report from a member of the public who suspected people were taking drugs in the vehicle. A search recovered approximately 44.5 grams of suspected crack cocaine, eight suspected e-cigarette cartridges and ice pipes, with a total estimated market value of about HK$45,000.

A 40-year-old man surnamed Wong and a 36-year-old man surnamed Yuen were arrested on suspicion of trafficking in a dangerous drug, possession of apparatus fit for the consumption of a dangerous drug, and possession of a Part I poison. They were detained for further inquiries by officers of the Kwai Tsing District Crime Investigation Team.

zh.headline: 青衣輕型貨車檢懷疑毒品 兩男涉販毒等被捕
zh.dek: 警方接報在青衣楓樹窩路一輛輕型貨車內檢獲約44.5克懷疑霹靂可卡因、電子煙彈及吸食工具，市值約4.5萬元，拘捕兩名男子。
body: 警方周二晚接獲途人報案，指懷疑有人在青衣楓樹窩路10號對開一輛輕型貨車內吸食毒品，人員到場搜查後發現懷疑危險藥物及相關物品。
車上檢獲約44.5克懷疑霹靂可卡因、8粒懷疑電子煙彈及冰壺，毒品總市值約4.5萬元。
一名40歲姓黃男子及一名36歲姓袁男子分別涉嫌販運危險藥物、藏有工具可作吸食毒品用途及管有第一部毒藥被捕，現正被扣留調查，案件由葵青警區刑事調查隊跟進。
